main.description: One organizer-owned attendee-facing occurrence, span, or milestone in an event program. It may be announced before its time or place is assigned.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this program item record was created. Preserved when scheduling details change.

credits.description: Ordered organizer-authored credits. Omitted for items such as doors opening that have no credited contributors.

description.description: A public description of this program item.

endsAt.description: The exact instant when this item ends. Requires startsAt and must be later than it.

event.description: The DID-based record URI of the events.openmusic.event containing this program item.

eventPlace.description: The DID-based events.openmusic.eventPlace assigned to this item. Omitted until a place is assigned.

media.description: Media attached to this particular occurrence. Array order is the organizer's preferred display order.

program.description: The DID-based events.openmusic.program this item belongs to.

schedule.description: The organizer-defined events.openmusic.schedule festival day assigned to this item. Omitted until a day is assigned.

startsAt.description: The exact instant when this item starts. Omitted until the start is assigned.

title.description: The organizer's public title for this occurrence, span, or milestone.
